export_compliance.exemption_reason: The app uses HTTPS (TLS) for network communication only — standard system-provided encryption for fetching aircraft data from public APIs. No custom encryption algorithms, no encryption of user data, no encryption services provided to third parties.

notes: Set 'Export Compliance Information' in App Store Connect → App Information → Content Rights to: 'Uses encryption: Yes, Exempt: Yes (uses only standard HTTPS)'. This avoids the export compliance warning on every build upload.
